# PROJ-1 — Create a customer

- **Ticket:** [PROJ-1](https://example.atlassian.net/browse/PROJ-1) · Bug · Medium
- **Cases:** TC_PROJ-1_01 – TC_PROJ-1_02

## Test cases

### TC_PROJ-1_01 — Customer saves with the given name

| # | Step | Expected result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Open Lists → Relationships → Customers → New | Customer form opens |
| 2 | Enter the name and save | Record saves; name is shown on the record |

### TC_PROJ-1_02 — Duplicate name is rejected

| # | Step | Expected result |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Create a second customer with the same name | Duplicate warning is shown |
